config.title: MediaWiki External Editor
config.port.description: Local WebSocket port; must match WS_URL in the userscript.
config.tempDir.description: Directory for source files. Leave empty to use the user cache directory: $XDG_CACHE_HOME/mediawiki-edit (Linux), ~/Library/Caches/mediawiki-edit (macOS), %LOCALAPPDATA%\mediawiki-edit (Windows).
config.allowedOrigin.description: Allowed browser origin; `*` means any origin, or a single origin such as https://example.org.
config.languageFeatures.description: Enable built-in language features for editing sessions (diagnostics, folding, completion, navigation, etc.).
config.diagnosticsWarnings.description: Include warnings in diagnostics; when off, only errors are shown.
config.diagnosticsDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing stops before running diagnostics.
config.diagnosticsMaxLength.description: Documents longer than this many characters are not diagnosed or semantically highlighted automatically; 0 means no limit.
config.parserConfig.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to a parser config JSON; leave empty to use the built-in default.
